findings.title: Missing progress bar in instruction card
findings.description: The instructionCard displays the step label but omits the thin progress bar that appears below it in the reference design. Add a 3px track-and-fill bar below instructionLabel using session.completedStepIndexes.length / recipe.steps.length to calculate fill width.

findings.title: CircularTimer visual inaccuracy
findings.description: The four-border rotation technique produces a stepped square outline, not a smooth circular arc. Progress from 0.1 to 0.24 shows no visual change, then jumps at 0.25 when the right border activates. Replace with react-native-svg Circle using strokeDasharray/strokeDashoffset for accurate arcs, or document this as a visual placeholder that does not match the reference.

findings.title: Redundant state updates
findings.description: Mini-player close button and Previous button both call stopVoice() then explicitly setShowVoicePlayer(false), but stopVoice() already does this. Remove the redundant calls. Change onPress={() => { stopVoice(); setShowVoicePlayer(false); }} to onPress={stopVoice}.

findings.title: TypeScript and lint verification missing
findings.description: No evidence that npx tsc --noEmit or npx expo lint were executed. The plan specifies these checks must run, but no output exists in the tasks directory. Type errors or lint violations may be present but undetected. Run both commands and address any reported issues before approval.

findings.title: ScrollView padding may be insufficient
findings.description: paddingBottom: 80 may not prevent overlap on devices with large bottom safe areas when the mini-player is visible. Test on iPhone 14 Pro Max with long content and active voice playback. If overlap occurs, increase to 100-120px.
